detail.readme:
# EA_SCALPER_XAUUSD — Algorithmic trading research lab > **PT-BR:** laboratório pessoal de engenharia de software para sistemas financeiros, mantido por Franco Mascarelo Ortiz desde agosto de 2025. Este repositório é o snapshot público (MQL5). O núcleo em Python (NautilusTrader) é privado. É pesquisa: só backtest, nunca operou dinheiro real, sem sinais e sem promessa de lucro. A personal engineering lab for financial software, built and maintained by one person since August 2025. This repository is the **public MQL5 snapshot**. The Python/NautilusTrader core is private. **Status:** research only. Backtest only. It has never traded real money. No signals, no profit claims, no trading advice. Just the engineering. --- ## Why this exists I started out buying trading robots. I stopped when I realized that, even if one worked, I would depend on an outside developer and would not be able to explain why it stopped working. So I built my own lab: a place to test ideas about markets with the same discipline that financial systems need. The most useful result so far is not a strategy. It is the engineering, and the list of ideas the tests ruled out. ## What the lab does - **Event-by-event backtesting** on NautilusTrader (Python 3.14), with deterministic replay checked by SHA-256 traces. - **Platform integration** with MetaTrader 5 (MQL5) and NinjaTrader 8 (C# AddOn). MQL5 logic is checked against a Python reference implementation. - **Statistical validation:** walk-forward analysis, block-bootstrap Monte Carlo, Probabilistic and Deflated Sharpe Ratio, PBO (CSCV), placebo / sign-flip tests. Failure criteria are written before the test runs. - **Fail-closed by design:** unknown input resolves to the most restrictive choice; missing data is reported as "unavailable", never silently treated as zero. - **Test discipline:** mutation testing, property-based tests (Hypothesis), and differential tests whose references are written from the specification, not from the implementation. - **Realistic execution modeling:** slippage only adverse, queue-aware fills, no fill assumed at probability 1. ## How it is built I coordinate several AI coding agents in parallel. Each lead works in its own git worktree with its own plan, and I integrate the work into a central branch. - Whoever writes the code does not approve it. Critical changes need two independent reviewers who **run** the code, not only read it. - "Done" is only valid with the reviewer's verdict file cited. Anything that did not pass stays marked as partial. - Claims are checked against the command that produced them before commit. Architecture, acceptance criteria and decisions are mine. ## Scale (private repository, measured November 2026) | Measure | Value | |---|---| | Commits | 5,400+ | | Python, production and tests | 1M+ lines | | Automated test functions | 30,000+ (static count of `def test_`) | | Age | ~15 months (since August 2025) | These numbers describe effort, not quality or profitability. ## Architecture (simplified) ```mermaid flowchart LR subgraph Data["Data"] MT5["MetaTrader 5
(MQL5)"] --> Bus["Versioned events
(JSONL)"] NT8["NinjaTrader 8
AddOn (C#)"] --> Bus Bus --> Replay["Recorder + replay"] end subgraph Core["Core (private)"] Replay --> Engine["Backtest engine
(NautilusTrader)"] Engine --> Risk["Risk layer
(fail-closed)"] end subgraph Validation["Validation"] Engine --> Stats["Walk-forward · Monte Carlo
DSR/PSR · PBO · placebo"] Engine --> Det["Determinism gate
(SHA-256 traces)"] end ``` ## What the data ruled out In June 2026 the strategy research program was closed without a proven edge: the pre-registered strategy families were rejected by their own tests. No configuration has shown a statistically valid, cost-adjusted advantage. That is why this is presented as an engineering lab, not as a product. ## What is public and what is not | Public (this repo) | Private | |---|---| | MQL5 Expert Advisors and indicators | Python/NautilusTrader core | | Docs, CI and tooling | Strategy rules and parameters | | | Risk configuration and live wiring | ## What this is not - Not a trading signal, course or service. - Not financial advice. - Not production-ready. - Not allowed for live, funded or broker-connected use. See [TRADING_RESTRICTIONS.md](TRADING_RESTRICTIONS.md). ## Author Franco Mascarelo Ortiz — Computer Engineering student (Uniftec, Brazil), studying COBOL and mainframe (Enterprise COBOL, JCL, z/OS, DB2).
